punchline: Paul Brand found that leprosy patients were injured by pain they could not feel.
thirty_sec: In India, surgeon Paul Brand saw leprosy patients walking on wounded feet and holding hands in live coals without flinching. He concluded that much of the damage came from lost pain, since unnoticed injuries turned into chronic infection. The Art of Happiness cites his view that pain protects the body.
question: Which recurring discomfort in your work or home life have you been dulling instead of asking what it warns about?
key_contrast: Ask what the pain protects before you silence it.
